import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Turn a title into a URL slug."""
    # Normalize Unicode: decompose accents so é -> e + combining mark,
    # then strip the combining marks to get a pure ASCII "cafe".
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
    text = "".join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    # Lowercase and replace any run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single dash.
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text.lower())
    return text.strip("-")
